name: AI Usage (aiu)
description:
Your AI subscription quotas and balances (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenAI) in the top bar, with advice on which one to use first.

Requires the aiu command-line tool. Install it first with
uv tool install git+https://github.com/citizenu03bb/aiu
or pipx install git+https://github.com/citizenu03bb/aiu
Until then, the panel shows this command with a Copy button.

Preferences: turn providers on or off and say where aiu finds each key (a variable, a command or a file, never the key itself).

Clipboard: the panel writes the install command to the clipboard only when you click Copy command. It never reads the clipboard.

English and French.
